text:
kelly: PR up for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — updates Node + Go examples for embeddings and fixes header rendering. Need green CI and one more approval to merge today (ideally before the docs deploy). can someone take a quick look? 🙏

sam: I can glance now. Any specific parts you want eyes on? Node streaming example or the Go client idioms?

kelly: Mainly the Node example (streaming + concurrency note) and a tiny Go snippet fix (context usage + missing fmt in imports). Steps: `npm run docs:smoke` and run `node examples/embed.js` locally if you can.

jordan: I'll run the smoke tests and check the rendered preview. CI shows a go fmt failure on linux runner earlier.

devex-bot: CI update: docs-build #482 — Node checks: ✅, Go fmt: ❌ (golangci-lint / gofmt), preview generated: https://deploy.preview/redwood/482 (partial)

sam: Found the gofmt issue — trailing space in example import block. Pushed a tiny fix to the branch (force-push). PTAL at the Go snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()
res, err := client.Embeddings(ctx, req)
```
I added the defer cancel to avoid leaking goroutine; also clarified error handling.

jordan: smoke tests passed for Node (embedding local run). Preview looks good but the code block for `max_tokens` under examples got reindented; small markdown lint warning.

kelly: thanks both. jordan — can you add that lint nit as a one-line follow-up or call it out here? I can patch if you're swamped.

jordan: i'll push a one-line fix for the markdown indent in a sec.

sam: LGTM from me on the Node changes. Approving on GitHub.

jordan: LGTM as well, left a cosmetic comment about env var naming (REPO_TOKEN vs DOCS_API_KEY) — not a blocker. Approved.

kelly: awesome. plan: @sam if you can squash + merge, i'll run the final smoke check and then we let the scheduled docs deploy (16:30 PT) pick it up. If merge is delayed, we hold for Friday release window.

sam: will squash + merge in ~10m and run `npm run docs:smoke -- --ci` afterwards.

devex-bot: Deploy preview updated: https://deploy.preview/redwood/482 — visual diff generated.

jordan: quick heads-up — i'll update the screenshot asset path in a follow-up PR (tiny).

kelly: thanks everyone :thumbsup: merging when green.

devex-bot: ✅ Merged by sam — PR #482 merged into main. Docs deploy started (job id docs-deploy-1998765).

kelly: thank you all. i'll add a note in the release notes about the example wording change and keep an eye on any regressions post-deploy.
